method: Root entry = body cites a dhātupāṭha (kavikalpadruma/durgādāsa/mādhavīya/…). Features: preraṇe/ṇijanta=causative, sew/aniw=seṭ/aniṭ, BvAdi=class-1. The other gaṇa names collide with the -ādi suffix and are excluded.
caveats: PROTOTYPE. SKD cites kavikalpadruma consistently (clean ~2.1k roots); VCP cites its source by name far less, so VCP roots here are a LOWER BOUND (cf. 1,980 seṭ markers). The point: SKD/VCP read 0 under m1's <ab> apparatus but carry thousands of roots — the 0 was detector blindness (MICROSTRUCTURE_ZERO_MEANING.md).
